highlights.title: The Power of the Limbic System in Emotional Control
highlights.hook_sentence: The limbic system, particularly the amygdala, controls 80% of our emotional responses, often overriding rational thought in just 13 seconds.
highlights.virality_reason: Combines neuroscience with relatable human behavior, offering actionable insights for emotional regulation.

highlights.title: Grip Strength and Dementia Risk Correlation
highlights.hook_sentence: Poor grip strength significantly increases the likelihood of developing dementia, highlighting a surprising physical indicator of cognitive health.
highlights.virality_reason: Links physical fitness to brain health, appealing to wellness and longevity-focused audiences.

highlights.title: Breaking the Limbic Loop for Rational Thinking
highlights.hook_sentence: To think clearly, you must break the limbic loop by prioritizing tasks that serve your goals over emotional distractions.
highlights.virality_reason: Offers a practical strategy for improving decision-making, resonating with productivity and self-help communities.
